we_process_text_you_enter_or_select_to_g: We process text you enter or select to generate replies and ideas and to check safety. Revisions also process your feedback and the previous generated result. We do not collect whole pages or browsing history. Text selected through the Chrome extension's context menu is temporarily stored in browser session storage, then read and removed when the panel opens.
when_you_generate_or_revise_a_result_you: When you generate or revise a result, your input—and, for revisions, your feedback and previous result—are automatically redacted and sent through Convex to TypeSafe AI for a safety check. When using your free or purchased balance, Google Gemini generates the result, which is also checked by TypeSafe AI. With your own API key, the browser sends the generation request directly to Google. Automatic redaction is not complete. Do not enter real names, secrets or contact details.
first_time_connections_use_cloudflare_tu: First-time connections use Cloudflare Turnstile. Payments take place on Stripe's page. We do not store card numbers. Each provider's terms apply to its processing.
if_you_sign_in_clerk_handles_your_email_: If you sign in, Clerk handles your email address, password or verification code, and sign-in state. Monku Fusion verifies Clerk's authenticated user identifier in Convex and links it to your connected balance and liked public ideas. We do not send your input or generated results to Clerk.
with_google_sign_in_clerk_receives_your_: With Google sign-in, Clerk receives your Google account identifier, email address and basic information such as name and profile picture for authentication and account management. We do not request access to Gmail messages, contacts or Google Drive files. Your Google password is handled on Google's page and is not sent to Monku Fusion.
a_secret_connection_token_is_stored_in_y: A secret connection token is stored in your browser. Its hash, remaining uses, and processing and payment identifiers are stored on the server. Your original input and revision feedback are not automatically saved in the app database. Content you enter in the publication field and agree to publish is stored as public data. Generated results are kept privately for retries and scheduled for deletion after about 24 hours. Request identifiers, status and input hashes are retained to prevent duplicate charges. Payment records and balances are retained as needed for operation.
linking_your_current_connection_when_sig: Linking your current connection when signed in removes the connection token from the browser and lets you recover your balance through your account. Likes are saved to your account. A list of people who liked a post is not public.
a_gemini_api_key_entered_in_the_extensio: A Gemini API key entered in the extension is stored within the extension and used only to authenticate with Google. On the Web, the key stays in page memory and is cleared on reload. We do not send the key to our server.
the_web_interface_language_skin_and_outp: The Web interface language, skin and output language are saved in this browser. Displayed input, feedback and result comparison history remain in page memory and are lost on reload. Copying and downloading text happen only when you choose them and do not publish or additionally save data to our server. Exports include the input used for generation and revision feedback.
results_are_not_published_automatically_: Results are not published automatically. Review and publish posts the seven displayed result fields, the generation mode, your selected genres and the context description you reviewed and edited to the archive under CC0. The initial context draft is an AI interpretation. The result text and context description are checked by TypeSafe AI before publication. The mode and genres are validated against the available options. Original input, revision feedback and earlier results are not automatically published. Connection tokens and payment information are not public. You can withdraw publication from the result screen or from My posts after signing in. Withdrawal cannot revoke copies or CC0 permissions already obtained by others.
you_can_clear_your_api_key_in_settings_i: You can clear your API key in Settings. If using the service without signing in, connect another device before clearing browser storage, or you may lose access to your balance. The operator is monku.ai. Contact us about data handling or deletion. Do not send API keys, connection codes or card numbers.
we_have_not_implemented_advertising_use_: We have not implemented advertising use, data sales or tracking.
monku_fusion_is_an_ai_tool_that_suggests: Monku Fusion is an AI tool that suggests constructive replies and ideas from text. It does not guarantee another person's psychology, the outcome of a conversation, acquisition of rights or effects on patents. Review the content before sending or publishing it.
your_first_connection_receives_3_free_us: Your first connection receives 3 free uses. Each purchase provides 10 uses for ¥100 including tax. Each generation or revision using your free or purchased balance deducts 1 use. Failed generation is refunded, and interrupted processing is refunded after about 3 minutes. Duplicate requests are treated as the same operation. Limits apply for demand and abuse prevention.
before_sign_in_your_balance_is_managed_t: Before sign-in, your balance is managed through an anonymous connection. Deleted or lost connection details cannot be automatically recovered. Before purchasing, sign in to link your balance or connect another device or the extension. Using your own Gemini API key does not deduct uses from your balance; Google's fees and limits apply.
submit_only_content_you_have_the_right_t: Submit only content you have the right to publish. Do not publish others' personal information or secrets. CC0 applies to generated results and context descriptions you review and publish. Removing them from the archive cannot recall copies held by others.
contact_us_to_discuss_refunds_for_your_u: Contact us to discuss refunds for your unused balance. Include the purchase date and evidence such as a Stripe receipt. Do not send API keys, connection codes or card numbers. Uses for failed generation are returned automatically.

10_uses_100_including_tax_each_purchase_: 10 uses: ¥100 including tax. Each purchase is a one-time payment, not a subscription. You pay your own internet connection costs. Using your own Gemini API key may incur separate charges under your agreement with Google.
payment_is_by_credit_card_through_stripe: Payment is by credit card through Stripe at checkout. After payment is confirmed, 10 uses are added to the connected user. If they do not appear, refresh your balance and contact us if the issue persists.
contact_us_to_discuss_refunds_for_your_u: Contact us to discuss refunds for your unused balance. Include the purchase date and evidence such as a receipt. Uses for failed generation are returned automatically.

retire_intro: Your login, likes and connection details will be removed. Connected extensions will lose access and all unused uses will expire.
retire_retention: Keeping posts anonymously does not change their text. Withdraw any posts containing your name or identifying details first. External copies and existing CC0 permissions cannot be revoked. Payment records needed for reconciliation are kept without the account link.
retire_agree: I agree that my {0} remaining uses will expire and account deletion cannot be undone. I will contact support before deleting my account if I need to discuss a refund.
retire_confirm: Delete your account now? Public posts will be handled as selected. Your account, likes and unused uses will be removed.
retire_pending: Account deletion accepted. Your account and related data are being processed. This continues if you close the page.
retire_delayed: Deletion is taking longer than expected and will retry automatically. Contact support if it does not finish after a while.
retire_complete: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using Monku Fusion.
retire_status_failed: We could not check deletion progress. Processing continues on the server. Please check again.
retire_legal: You can delete your account in Settings and choose to delete public posts or keep them without their account link. Post text is not rewritten. Likes, connections and temporary results are deleted; unused uses expire with your consent. The Clerk account is also deleted. Payment reconciliation records and minimal information needed to recognize retired accounts are retained. Processing continues after the page is closed and retries on failure. Contact us before deleting your account if you wish to discuss a refund.
